🏛️ 12 Entry Points

Farm Payments

Basic Payment Scheme (BPS) / Delinked Payments

Transition from EU CAP Basic Payment Scheme to delinked payments (2024–2027). £1.8B+ annual payment processing. Claim validation automation. Land parcel eligibility verification. Progressive reduction modelling. 85,000+ claimants managed.

Environmental Land

Environmental Land Management Schemes (ELMs)

Sustainable Farming Incentive (SFI), Countryside Stewardship (CS), and Landscape Recovery. Payment-by-results monitoring. Biodiversity net gain verification. Soil health assessment. 32,000+ agreements active across 70% of agricultural land.

Land Registry

Rural Land Registry & RPA Digital Mapping

Rural Payments Agency digital mapping system. Land parcel boundaries (25M+ parcels). Cross-compliance verification. Digital twinning of agricultural land use. Satellite-validated land cover classification.

Food Security

Food Security Assessment & Supply Chain

UK food security monitoring across domestic production (60% self-sufficiency). Import dependency tracking. Supply chain resilience modelling. Seasonal labour forecasting. Cold chain logistics optimisation. £120B+ food supply chain governed.

Livestock

Animal & Plant Health Agency (APHA) Surveillance

Livestock disease surveillance (BVD, TB, Bluetongue). Movement licensing AI. Slaughter notification processing. Notifiable disease outbreak response. TB testing compliance. 50,000+ registered holdings monitored.

Fisheries

Marine Management Organisation (MMO) Licensing

UK fishing vessel licensing post-Brexit. Quota allocation AI. Catch documentation automation. Marine conservation zone compliance. Under-12m fleet tracking. 6,000+ licensed vessels governed.

Water Quality

Environment Agency Agricultural Pollution

Agricultural runoff monitoring. Catchment Sensitive Farming programme. Nutrient neutrality compliance. Water Framework Directive successor metrics. Manure management plan verification. 100+ catchment areas monitored.

Forestry

National Forest Inventory. Woodland creation targets (30,000ha/yr). Carbon sequestration verification. Tree health surveillance (ash dieback, acute oak decline). UK Forestry Standard compliance. 3.2M hectares managed.

Pesticides

Chemicals Regulation Division pesticide authorisation. Active substance review post-Brexit. Maximum residue level monitoring. Biopesticide fast-track assessment. Emergency authorisation governance. 500+ active substances managed.

Trade

Post-Brexit import biosecurity checks. Sanitary/Phytosanitary (SPS) certification. Risk-based categorisation of goods. Common Health Entry Document automation. £48B+ agri-food trade governed annually.

Data

Integrated agricultural data platform. Farm survey analytics. Agricultural census processing. Land use change detection. Climate impact modelling for farming. Cross-DEFRA data sharing governance.

Agricultural policy scrutiny. Food security reporting. Farm payment efficiency review. Environmental land management effectiveness. Rural economy accountability. Post-EU agricultural legislation oversight.

7. Biosecurity Border Intelligence

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No automated subsidy denial without human RPA caseworker review and appeal pathway
  • ❌ No livestock culling decisions without veterinary officer and APHA epidemiologist review
  • ❌ No land parcel boundary changes without landowner notification and 28-day objection period
  • ❌ No pesticide authorisation override without HSE CRD toxicology panel assessment
  • ❌ No fishing quota allocation changes without MMO Fisheries Minister approval
  • ❌ No food import blocking without SPS risk assessor and Border Force joint determination
